summary: Use runtime semantics for Set construction from an arbitrary iterable because iterator and adder hooks are observable.

target.notes: Runtime must Get(add), consume the sync iterator, Call(adder) for each value, and IteratorClose on abrupt completion.

tests.name: adder throw closes iterator
tests.input: let closed=false; class S extends Set{add(){throw 1}}; const it={ [Symbol.iterator](){return {next(){return {value:1,done:false}},return(){closed=true;return {done:true}}}}}; try{new S(it)}catch(e){} console.log(closed);
